&NowDate.FromString(&WebSession.Get(!"FechaInicialConsulta"))
	
	&AuditTableName = !'Carrera'
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	TFCarreraFechaRegistro_RangePicker.Attach(&DDO_CarreraFechaRegistroAuxDateText.InternalName)
	
	Grid.Rows = Page.Rows
	Grid_Empowerer.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	ddo_AGExport.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnAGExport.InternalName
	&AGExportData = new()
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'Export'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExportReport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'ExportReport'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	DDC_Subscriptions.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnSubscriptions.InternalName
	
	&IsAuthorized_CarreraNo = SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'carreraview_Execute')
	
	&IsAuthorized_InicioPrensadoBobinaNoSerie = SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'bobinaview_Execute')
	
	&IsAuthorized_CarreraInterrupcionMotivo = SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'interrupcionview_Execute')
	
	&GAMSession = GAMSession.Get(&GAMErrors)
	DDO_Grid.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_Grid.GAMOAuthToken = &GAMSession.Token
	Form.Caption = ' Carrera'
	Do 'PrepareTransaction'
	Do 'LoadGridState'
	If &OrderedBy < 1
		&OrderedBy = 1
		Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
	EndIf
	If &HTTPRequest.Method = HttpMethod.Get
		Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndIf
	&DDO_TitleSettingsIcons = GetWWPTitleSettingsIcons()
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnEditColumns.InternalName
	GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue = Grid.Rows
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	Do 'CheckSecurityForActions'
	Do Case
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 1
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 0
			Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndCase
	Do 'SaveGridState'
	
	If &Session.Get(!'DB.CarreraWWColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'DB.CarreraWWColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf
	CarreraNo.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(1).IsVisible
	CarreraEstado.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(2).IsVisible
	CarreraPaletTerminado.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(3).IsVisible
	CarreraFechaRegistro.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(4).IsVisible
	InicioPBPrensadoId.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(5).IsVisible
	InicioPBPrensaNombre.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(6).IsVisible
	InicioPBTurnoNombre.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(7).IsVisible
	InicioPrensadoBobinaNoSerie.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(8).IsVisible
	CarreraInterrupcionId.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(9).IsVisible
	CarreraInterrupcionMotivo.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(10).IsVisible
	CarreraInterrupcionTiempo.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(11).IsVisible
	CarreraDownTimeCode.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(12).IsVisible
	CarreraDownTimeDescription.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(13).IsVisible
	&GridCurrentPage = Grid.CurrentPage
	&GridPageCount = Grid.PageCount
	&GridAppliedFilters = WWP_GetAppliedFiltersDescription(&Pgmname)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Previous'
			Grid.PreviousPage()
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Next'
			Grid.NextPage()
		Otherwise
			&PageToGo.FromString(GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage)
			Grid.GotoPage(&PageToGo)
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderASC#>' OR DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>'
			&OrderedBy.FromString(DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get)
			&OrderedDsc = iif(DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>', true, false)
			Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
			Grid.FirstPage()
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Filter#>'
			Do Case
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'TagColumn'
					&GridConditionalFormattingFilter.FromString(DDO_Grid.SelectedColumnFixedFilter)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'CarreraNo'
					&TFCarreraNo.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFCarreraNo_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'CarreraEstado'
					&TFCarreraEstado_SelsJson = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
					&TFCarreraEstado_Sels.FromJson(&TFCarreraEstado_SelsJson)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'CarreraPaletTerminado'
					&TFCarreraPaletTerminado = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFCarreraPaletTerminado_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'CarreraFechaRegistro'
					&TFCarreraFechaRegistro.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFCarreraFechaRegistro_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
					If Not &TFCarreraFechaRegistro_To.IsEmpty()
						&TFCarreraFechaRegistro_To.Set(&TFCarreraFechaRegistro_To.Year(), &TFCarreraFechaRegistro_To.Month(), &TFCarreraFechaRegistro_To.Day(), 23, 59, 59)
					EndIf
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'InicioPBPrensadoId'
					&TFInicioPBPrensadoId.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFInicioPBPrensadoId_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'InicioPBPrensaNombre'
					&TFInicioPBPrensaNombre = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFInicioPBPrensaNombre_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'InicioPBTurnoNombre'
					&TFInicioPBTurnoNombre = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFInicioPBTurnoNombre_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'InicioPrensadoBobinaNoSerie'
					&TFInicioPrensadoBobinaNoSerie = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFInicioPrensadoBobinaNoSerie_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'CarreraInterrupcionId'
					&TFCarreraInterrupcionId.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFCarreraInterrupcionId_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'CarreraInterrupcionMotivo'
					&TFCarreraInterrupcionMotivo = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFCarreraInterrupcionMotivo_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'CarreraInterrupcionTiempo'
					&TFCarreraInterrupcionTiempo.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFCarreraInterrupcionTiempo_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'CarreraDownTimeCode'
					&TFCarreraDownTimeCode = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFCarreraDownTimeCode_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'CarreraDownTimeDescription'
					&TFCarreraDownTimeDescription = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFCarreraDownTimeDescription_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
			EndCase
			Grid.FirstPage()
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */ &cmdEtiqueta = !'' &Display = "GXM_display" If (&IsAuthorized_Display) &Display.Link = CarreraView.Link(CarreraId, '') Endif &Update = "GXM_update" If (&IsAuthorized_Update) &Update.Link = DB.Carrera.Link(TrnMode.Update, CarreraId) Endif &Delete = "GX_BtnDelete" If (&IsAuthorized_Delete) &Delete.Link = Carrera.Link(TrnMode.Delete, CarreraId) Endif If (&IsAuthorized_CarreraNo) CarreraNo.Link = CarreraView.Link(CarreraId, '') Endif If (&IsAuthorized_InicioPrensadoBobinaNoSerie) InicioPrensadoBobinaNoSerie.Link = BobinaView.Link(InicioPrensadoBobinaBoninaId, '') Endif If (&IsAuthorized_CarreraInterrupcionMotivo) CarreraInterrupcionMotivo.Link = InterrupcionView.Link(CarreraInterrupcionId, '') Endif Do Case Case CarreraEstado = EstadoCarrera.EnProceso &GridBadge = "En Proceso" &GridBadge.TooltipText = "En Proceso" &GridBadge.Class = !' AttributeTagWarning BootstrapTooltipRight' Case CarreraEstado = EstadoCarrera.Terminada &GridBadge = "Terminada" &GridBadge.TooltipText = "Terminada" &GridBadge.Class = !' AttributeTagInfo BootstrapTooltipRight' Case CarreraEstado = EstadoCarrera.Validada &GridBadge = "Validada" &GridBadge.TooltipText = "Validada" &GridBadge.Class = !' AttributeTagSuccess BootstrapTooltipRight' Otherwise &GridBadge = '' &GridBadge.TooltipText = '' &GridBadge.Class = !'' EndCase /* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Clean#>'
			Do 'CleanFilters'
			Grid.FirstPage()
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Save#>'
			Do 'SaveGridState'
			SaveFilterAs.Popup(!'DB.CarreraWWFilters', &PgmName + !"GridState")
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Manage#>'
			ManageFilters.Popup(!'DB.CarreraWWFilters')
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Otherwise
			&ManageFiltersXml = GetFilterByName(!'DB.CarreraWWFilters', ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey)
			If &ManageFiltersXml.IsEmpty()
				msg('WWP_FilterNotExist')
			Else
				Do 'CleanFilters'
				SaveGridState.Call(&PgmName + !"GridState",  &ManageFiltersXml)
				&GridState.FromXml(&ManageFiltersXml)
				&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
				&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc
				Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus' 
				Do 'LoadRegFiltersState'
				Grid.FirstPage()
				Refresh
			EndIf
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If (&IsAuthorized_Insert)
		DB.Carrera.Call(TrnMode.Insert, nullvalue(CarreraId))
	Else
		msg("WWP_ActionNoLongerAvailable")
		Refresh
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'Export'
			Do 'DoExport'
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'ExportReport'
			Do 'DoExportReport'
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If (&IsAuthorized_deletedRecords)
		WWPBaseObjects.AuditDeleted.Call(&AuditTableName)
	Else
		msg("WWP_ActionNoLongerAvailable")
		Refresh
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

&PDFNombre = 'Carrera' + CarreraId.ToString().Trim()
	&TipoMaterial = obtenertipoMaterialPorCarrete.Udp(CarreraId)
	Do Case
		Case &TipoMaterial = TipoMaterial.DOW
			CarreteReportMain.Call(0,CarreraId,&PDFNombre)
		Case &TipoMaterial = TipoMaterial.PCR
			CarreteReportMainPCR.Call(0,CarreraId,&PDFNombre)
	EndCase
	&Url = &HttpRequest.BaseUrl + &PDFNombre + '.pdf'
	&Window.Url =&Url 
	&Window.Open()
